text:
ops-bot: [ALERT] Dedicated us-west2 - p95 latency +3x since 06:10 UTC. Cold-start rate increased, throughput down. Grafana: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/serving/perf
Alex: seeing the same. Autoscaler shows more pending pods than usual.
Priya: kernel-selection histograms look noisy post-rollout at ~06:00. New heuristic bumped fallback frequency.
Jamal: KV cache hitrate dropped from ~92% to ~46% during the window. Likely cache not being primed after new kernels. :thinking:
Marta: did we change prefetch or KV priming behavior in the rollout?
Alex: checking rollout notes. I see featureflag kernel-v2 enabled in dedicated at 06:00 (canary -> gradual).
Priya: confirmed. kernel-v2 changes default kernel score threshold and disables eager KV prefetch for small seqs.
Jamal: impact: more model instances hitting empty KV, causing extra KV warmups which cascade into longer joins.
Alex: autoscaler timeline: before 06:00 median provision latency 7s, during spike 35s, peaks 52s. scale-controller logs attached.
Priya: quick profiler dump (sampling 100ms) shows hot paths during spike:
```
# sampling profile summary
kernel_select.evaluate 42.1%
kv_warmup.wait 18.4%
joiner.finalize 12.7%
batcher.flush 9.3%
other 17.5%
```
Marta: batcher.flush at 9% seems odd. Any change in batching heuristics?
Alex: yes, we also pushed batching tweak to reduce max latency by lowering target batch size (flush_interval_ms=10 -> 5). Smaller batches -> more concurrent joins -> more KV misses.
Jamal: noisy neighbor effect observed: a subset of hosts showed high GPU mem churn; evictions correlated with prefetch stalls.
Priya: hypothesis: kernel-v2 + aggressive batching -> higher cold-KV workload -> warm pool depleted faster -> scale-up backlog -> increased cold starts and p95.
Marta: can we mitigate quickly? Options: rollback kernel-v2, revert batching change, bump warm-pool target, enable eager KV prefetch.
Alex: tactical plan: 1) disable kernel-v2 in dedicated us-west2 (FF toggle) 2) revert batching flush_interval to 10ms 3) increase warm-pool desired count by +20% for 30m 4) enable KV eager prefetch flag on critical routes.
Priya: doing (1) now: `curl -XPOST https://flags.internal/ff/toggle -d '{"flag":"kernel-v2","env":"dedicated-us-west2","value":false}'`
deploy-bot: rollout job queued (job id 4421).
Alex: (2) reverting batching config via infra k8s patch. Patch applied to batcher config map.
Jamal: (3) scaled warm-pool: `redwoodctl scale warmpool --region us-west2 --delta +12` -> API returned 202.
Marta: (4) enabling KV prefetch for critical models (chat/completion) via feature flag.
Priya: metrics improving: p95 down from 3.2s to 1.1s within two minutes of kernel-v2 rollback. KV hitrate recovering to ~85%. :thumbsup:
Alex: throughput still ramping; autoscaler backlog dropping. Provision latency back to ~9s.
Jamal: will watch for noisy neighbor recurrence. Adding temporary isolation on noisy hosts.
Marta: create incident ticket and assign follow-ups (perf regression, rollout gating, chaos test for prefetch behavior).
Alex: filing INC-1245 and linking this thread.
deploy-bot: Created INC-1245: https://incidents.internal/INC-1245 - owners: Alex, Priya, Jamal.
Priya: short-term done. Postmortem next steps: collect full flamegraphs, kernel selection diff, batching telemetry, and warm-pool fill traces. I'll start gathering artifacts.
Alex: thanks all. We'll schedule a retro with runtime + infra to tighten rollout guardrails. :eyes:
